# Merriam-Webster

> America's most trusted dictionary featuring over 300,000 word definitions, language resources, word games, and vocabulary tools for learners and word enthusiasts.

Merriam-Webster is the premier English language dictionary publisher, offering comprehensive lexicographic resources including the Collegiate Dictionary, specialized references like slang dictionaries, and interactive tools such as Word Finder and daily vocabulary features. The platform serves students, educators, writers, and word game enthusiasts with authoritative definitions, pronunciation guides, and engaging language-learning content.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and reference
- Word games (Scrabble, Quordle, Blossom)
- Vocabulary building and language learning
- Word of the Day
- Collegiate Dictionary
- Slang and contemporary language
- Word Finder and Scrabble solver tools
- Mobile apps (iOS, Android)
- Student and kids dictionaries
- Letter unscrambler and word search
- Pronunciation guides
- Etymology and word origins
- Thesaurus and synonyms
- Grammar and usage guidance

## Core Dictionary & Reference

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage featuring 300,000+ word definitions and word games
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Product page for Collegiate Dictionary Twelfth Edition reference book
- [Slang Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Definitions for trending slang, Gen Z phrases, and internet terminology
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Kid-friendly dictionary with educational games like Quordle and Blossom

## Word Games & Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble solver and word game tool for finding words by letter patterns
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps including dictionary, Scrabble, and word game downloads

## Vocabulary & Learning

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary feature with podcast, email, and social media options
